freePlan.limits: Unlimited members, 2 teams, 250 issues, 10MB file upload

keyLimits.en: Unlimited members, 2 teams, 250 issues total, 10MB file uploads.
Billed annually only at this rate; 5 teams, unlimited issues and file uploads.
Billed annually only at this rate; unlimited teams and guests, Triage Intelligence, Loops, Code Intelligence, Insights.

cautions.en: Basic and Business list prices are annual-billing rates only; no monthly-billing price is published on the pricing page.
cautions.fr: Les prix Basic et Business affichés sont des tarifs à l'engagement annuel uniquement ; aucun tarif mensuel n'est publié.

capabilities.en: Issue tracking with cycles and project/initiative planning for product and engineering teams.
AI-powered workflows and agents to help move issues and product work forward.
Built-in analytics and insights for any stream of work.
Customer request and workplace request (Linear Asks) intake that converts into actionable issues.

limitations.en: Free plan is capped at 250 total issues and 2 teams, tight for any active engineering team.
Discounted per-seat pricing (Basic, Business) is only available with annual billing.
Advanced features (Triage Intelligence, Loops, Code Intelligence, Insights, guests) require the Business tier.

reason.en: Direct competitor: both are issue tracking and product development tools for engineering teams.
Overlapping use case for planning and tracking work, though Notion is broader in scope.
Alternative project/issue tracking tool aimed at product and team workflows.

unknowns: Whether Basic/Business plans offer any monthly-billing option at a higher price was not stated on the pricing page as fetched.
Exact list of native integrations beyond GitHub and Slack was not detailed on the features page as fetched.
